verdict.rationale: Handling SMS, WhatsApp, social or live chat alongside email is a fair question for an inbox product, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents only email capabilities: messages, rules, attachments, notes, delegation and change notifications. Nothing shows Outlook bringing other customer channels into the same inbox.

support.subject: As a team-lead, the same inbox also handles adjacent customer channels — SMS, WhatsApp, social, or live chat — beside email
